title: Cloud DBA Engineer
description:
**Req ID:** 388932

We are currently seeking a Cloud DBA Engineer to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Job Description
  
  
At NTT DATA, we know that with the right people on board, anything is possible. The quality, integrity, and commitment of our employees are key factors in our company’s growth, market presence and our ability to help our clients stay a step ahead of the competition. By hiring the best people and helping them grow both professionally and personally, we ensure a bright future for NTT DATA and for the people who work here.
  
  
Preferred Experience
  
  

* Ideal candidate has been supporting traditional server based relational databases (Postgresql and MongoDB) for over 5+ years out of which last 3+ years in public cloud environments (GCP).
* Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL/MongoDB, including installation, configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated expertise in managing PostgreSQL databases on AZURE, GCP and AWS RDS.
* Experience with features such as automated backups, maintenance, and scaling - Postgresql
* Ability to analyze and optimize complex SQL queries for performance improvement.
* Proficiency in setting up and managing monitoring tools for PostgreSQL on GCP.
* Experience with configuring alerts based on performance metrics.
* Experience in implementing and testing backup and recovery strategies for PostgreSQL databases on AWS RDS/AZURE SQL/GCP Cloud SQL.
* Knowledge and experience in designing and implementing disaster recovery plans for PostgreSQL databases on AWS RDS/AZURE SQL/GCP Cloud SQL.
* Good Understanding of database security principles and best practices.
* Proven ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in PostgreSQL databases.
* Experience in optimizing database configurations for better performance.
* Able to provide 24\*7 shift hours support at L2 level
* Experience in updating KB articles, Problem Management articles, and SOPs/runbooks
* Passion for delivering timely and outstanding customer service
* Great written and oral communication skills with internal and external customers
* Strong ITIL foundation experience
* Ability to work independently or no direct supervision.
* Share domain and technical expertise, providing technical mentorship and cross-training to other peers and team members.
* Work directly with end customer, business stakeholders as well as technical resources.
* Share domain and technical expertise, providing technical mentorship and cross-training to other peers and team members.
* Work directly with end customers, business stakeholders as well as technical resources."

Basic Qualifications
  
  

* 5+ years of overall operational experience
* 3+ years of GCP experience as a cloud DBA (Postgresql/Mongo DB)
* 3+ years of experience working in diverse cloud support database environments in a 24\*7 production support model
* Query fine tuning - MongoDB
* Shell scripts for Monitoring like ‘slow queries’, replication lag, nodes fails, disk usage. etc
* Backup and restores (Backups should be automated with shell scripts/Ops Manager)
* Database Health check (Complete review of Database slow queries, fragmentation, index usage. etc)
* Upgrades (Java version, Mongo version. etc)
* Maintenance (Data Centre outages etc)
* Architecture design as per the Application requirement
* Writing best practices documents for shading, replication for Dev/App teams
* Log rotation/ maintenance (mongos, mongodb, config etc)
* Segregation of duties (User Management – designing User roles and responsibilities)
* Designing DR (Disaster Recovery)/COB (Continuity of Business) plans as applicable
* Database Profiling, Locks, Memory Usage, No of connections, page fault etc.,
* Export and Import of Data to and From MongoDB, Run time configuration of MongoDB,
* Data Managements in MongoDB Capped Collections Expired data from TTL,
* Monitoring of Various issues related with Database,
* Monitoring at Server, Database, Collection Level, and Various Monitoring Tools related to MongoDB,
* Database software Installation and Configuration in accordance with Client defined standards.
* Database Migrations and Updates
* Capacity management- MongoDB
* Hands on experience in Server Performance tuning and Recommendations
* High availability solutions and recommendations
* Hands on experience in Root cause analysis for business impacting issues.
* Experience with SQL,SQL Developer, TOAD, Pgadmin, mongo db atlas
* Experience with python / powershell scripting - preferred
* Secondary skill in MySQL/oracle - preferred
* Installation, configuration and upgrading of postgresql server software and related products

Preferred Certifications
  
  
Azure fundamentals certification (AZ-900) - REQUIRED
  
  
Google Cloud Associate Engineer - REQUIRED
  
  
Azure Database Certification (DP-300) - preferred
  
  
AWS Certified Database Specialty - preferred
  
  
Postgresql certification a plus
  
  
MongoDB certification a plus
  
  
B.Tech/BE/MCA in Information Technology degree or equivalent experience
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. title: MongoDB Administrator
description:
**MongoDB Administrator**

**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Location:** Noida 63

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a skilled **MongoDB Administrator** to manage, maintain, and optimize our database environments. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in MongoDB administration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, replication, and high availability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage, monitor, and maintain MongoDB databases to ensure optimal performance, availability, and reliability.
* Implement and maintain backup, recovery, replication, and database security best practices.
* Monitor database health, including slow queries, replication lag, node failures, CPU and memory utilization, locks, connections, and index usage.
* Optimize query performance, troubleshoot database issues, and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Plan and execute database upgrades, maintenance activities, and patch deployments.
* Design, implement, and support High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions.
* Collaborate with application and infrastructure teams to assess the impact of database changes, optimize queries, and support application releases.
* Automate database deployment, monitoring, and maintenance tasks using scripting.
* Ensure database security, stability, and compliance with established operational standards.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of experience as a **MongoDB Administrator or DBA**.
* Strong knowledge of **MongoDB administration, performance tuning, replication, and backup and recovery**.
* Good understanding of enterprise **architecture, database systems, networking, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**.
* Proficiency in **Unix/Linux shell scripting and Python**.
* Hands-on experience working with **Linux and Windows environments**.
* Understanding of database high availability, disaster recovery, and security practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with database automation and monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of database performance optimization and capacity planning.
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation and enterprise database environments.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: SAP BASIS-Manager
description:
Location: Noida

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Sep 4, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1713055

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY GDS CONSULTING – SAP BASIS MANAGER**

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

As a SAP BASIS Manager, you will be at the forefront of managing and optimizing our SAP BASIS infrastructure and operations. This role offers you the chance to lead the administration, maintenance, and performance tuning of our SAP systems, ensuring stability, security, and high availability.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with functional teams, IT, and business stakeholders to enhance SAP system landscapes, implement best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Your expertise will be essential in addressing complex technical issues, managing system upgrades, patches, and ensuring compliance with IT policies and regulatory requirements.

In this position, you will also play a key role in mentoring and leading a team of BASIS administrators, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing, skill development, and innovation. You will be part of a dynamic team that values technical excellence and is committed to delivering exceptional SAP services to support business objectives.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Performance monitoring and tuning, issue diagnosis, root‑cause analysis, and resolution.
* SAP administration on UNIX & Windows environments.
* System copy/refresh planning and execution.
* Administration of ABAP + Java dual‑stack systems.
* Add‑on installation, Support Pack updates, and post‑implementation troubleshooting.
* Kernel upgrades and patching.
* Client copies, export/import operations.
* TMS administration, transport configuration, and troubleshooting transport errors.
* SAP system monitoring, log analysis, workload analysis, and early‑watch checks.
* SAP parameter optimization, operation mode setup, logon group configuration.
* SAP authorization knowledge: role analysis, creation, and troubleshooting access issues.
* Spool administration and troubleshooting print/spool issues.
* OSS Note implementation and correction deployments.
* Experience with Single Sign‑On, certificates, SNC, Web Dispatcher routing & load balancing.
* Strong experience managing SAP on public and private clouds.
* Hands‑on experience working with Azure, AWS, and GCP cloud platforms.
* Experience in SAP user provisioning, role assignments, and troubleshooting authorization conflicts.
* Understanding of OS/DB migration and heterogeneous migration concepts.
* Familiarity with SAP connectivity components such as Gateway, Web Dispatcher, RFCs, Cloud Connector, etc.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Should have 9 to 10 years of experience in the SAP Basis domain with strong leadership responsibilities.
* Solid hands‑on experience in SAP system administration including installation, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of SAP architecture, transport management (CTS, CTS+), kernel upgrades, client strategies, and system refresh processes.
* Expertise in SAP HANA administration (performance tuning, monitoring, backup/recovery, memory optimization, and troubleshooting).
* Experience managing SAP landscapes such as S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, Web Dispatcher, and Gateway.
* Strong knowledge of SAP BTP, integration services, and administration fundamentals.
* Experience managing RISE with SAP environments and cloud operational activities.
* Strong documentation skills ensuring structured, compliant, and audit‑ready system documentation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills with experience working with senior leadership.
* In‑depth expertise in Solution Manager functionalities including CHARM, EWA, Monitoring, System Recommendations, and Change Control Management.
* Experience using Signavio for business process modeling and process governance.
* Experience with LeanIX for enterprise architecture management, application portfolio mapping, and landscape documentation.
* Manage SAP High Availability (HA) & Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies.
* Optimize HANA database performance, backup, and restore strategies.
* Knowledge of Linux, Windows, and cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Familiarity with SAP security, patching, and encryption methodologies.
* Performance Optimization & System Security:
  + Analyse and improve SAP system performance, load balancing, and scalability.
  + Optimize memory management, SAP buffers, work processes, and background jobs.
  + Conduct security audits, role-based access control (RBAC), and risk assessments.
  + Ensure SAP systems comply with GDPR, SOX, ISO, and industry regulations.

* Cloud & Infrastructure Management:
  + Support SAP Cloud deployments (SAP BTP, Azure, AWS, GCP, or private cloud).
  + Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for SAP automation using Ansible/Terraform.
  Manage hybrid cloud integrations and connectivity between on-prem & cloud SAP environments
* Soft Skills:
  + Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
  + Ability to work under pressure in a high-availability production environment.
  + Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  + Leadership experience in guiding SAP Basis teams and collaborating with cross-functional teams

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Practical experience managing SAP workloads on Azure or AWS (VM management, storage classes, networking, monitoring).
* Exposure to SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) for monitoring, operations, and change control.
* Experience in SAP Data Archiving (OpenText, ILM).

  

**Certifications:**

* SAP Technology Associate (SAP Basis, HANA).
* SAP Cloud Certifications (RISE, BTP, HANA Cloud).
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  

**What we offer you**

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

  

**Our Commitment**: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

**Professional Development**: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

**People and Culture**: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

**Benefits**: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

**How to Apply**: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Over the last decade, enterprise application modernization and cloud adoption have become critical to ensuring scalability, availability, and cost optimization for global organizations. title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
**Role Overview**

The 'Senior Database Administrator' will be responsible for managing, securing, optimising and automating enterprise database platforms across on-premises and cloud environments. The role focuses on database performance, availability, security, backup and recovery, and operational reliability, while supporting modern data platforms through automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD and DevOps practices.

**Experience Required:** 4 - 7 Years

**Job Type:** Permanent

**Job Location:** Noida Sector 144

**Work Model:** Hybrid / Remote

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer, monitor and optimise Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance environments.
* Manage database upgrades, patching, migrations, performance tuning, capacity planning, backups and recovery testing.
* Implement and maintain database security, access controls, encryption, auditing, High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions.
* Support Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric and Azure Storage.
* Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Azure CLI or similar tools, and manage infrastructure deployments using Terraform.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps YAML, Git and database deployment tools such as Redgate SQL Change Automation.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers, Developers and Architects to support ETL/ELT workloads, data warehouses, lakehouses and enterprise data integrations.
* Implement monitoring, alerting, automated health checks and remediation processes; support incident management and root cause analysis.
* Follow data governance, quality, retention and compliance requirements within controlled production environments.
* Leverage approved AI tools to assist with SQL query optimisation, script generation, troubleshooting and database documentation, validating all outputs before implementation.
* Explore AI-assisted anomaly detection, performance monitoring and automation opportunities while ensuring data confidentiality, security and compliance with organisational AI policies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300) preferred.
* Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900), Microsoft Fabric and Terraform certifications are desirable.
* ITIL Foundation certification is an advantage.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in database administration, including production support for Microsoft SQL Server.
* Strong knowledge of SQL performance tuning, database design, backup/recovery, HA/DR and database security.
* Hands-on experience with Azure SQL services and hybrid/cloud-based data platforms.
* Practical experience with PowerShell or similar scripting, Terraform, Git and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
* Exposure to Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric and data warehouse/lakehouse solutions.
* Understanding of DataOps, data governance, monitoring and observability practices.
* Experience working in Agile teams and regulated, change-controlled environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation and stakeholder communication skills.
